exact_statement: Version5 retains v4 and earlier conclusions at their original scopes. For every Boolean sign controller a=1-2c on a fresh uniform physical cube and arbitrary Boolean branches G,H on an independent data cube, with any amount of shared data, put p=Ec, gamma=Pr(G!=H), F=(1-c)G+cH, Q=gamma I(a), R=2p(1-p)I(GH). The complete control-only stopping-tree signed entropy bill Pi=H(F)-(1-p)H(G)-pH(H) obeys Pi<=gamma Hplus(a)+log2(e)gamma Var(a)+2log2(e)Q+R <=gamma Hplus(a)+3log2(e)Q+R, where Hplus is raw nonempty Fourier entropy. Thus controller Hplus<=K I gives rate K+3log2(e) against Q, plus the one R bank; a strong Hplus<=T(I-Var) certificate gives max(T,log2(e))+2log2(e). With certified terminal allowances L_G,L_H, full path plus terminal cost is at most max(K+3log2(e),L_G+2p,L_H+2(1-p))I(F), with the analogous strong-controller substitution. Calibrating all shared-only atoms yields one normalized complete output reference with CE=(1-p)CE_Gcal+pCE_Hcal+Pi and KL=(1-p)D_Gcal+pD_Hcal, including off-target private mass. Under arbitrary adaptive physical control/data interleaving the same source boundary bank is a nonnegative supermartingale: controller release=(p0-p1)^2 I(GH)/2; data release=2p(1-p)Inf_i(GH)<=2Inf_i(F). For every stopped tree Rroot=sum reach-weighted releases+expected terminal R; marks are not reissued. Release-alone data entropy payment is false even for a dictator controller,G=+1,H=data dictator: root H=2, data release1/2, excess3/2, so an added local data price must be at least3 in the tested residual rule. No local mixed-query entropy price, nested renewal, universal controller/terminal FEI certificate, integer prefix rounding or full FEI is asserted.
